# dsh-bhky-medical-device-skills
Package five medical-device skills as a **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)** profile bundle:

- `jim-13485-gmp` — GMP / ISO 13485 quality-system documents
- `jim-sted-mdr-50k` — international te

chnical documentation (STED, MDR, 510(k)); display name `jim-STED-MDR-50K`
- `jim-reg-kb` — regulato

ry knowledge base; display name `jim-法规-知识库`
- `jim-bartender-ifu` — labeling and IFU
- `jim-checksh
elf` — compliance self-check scorecard
## What it does
- One Cordis plugin (`inject: ["skills"]`) that registers the `medxpert-skills` provider on `ctx.ski

lls`.
- Scans `skills/*/SKILL.md`, parses the YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`, optional `inv

ocation`)
and advertises every skill to the host catalog.
- Bodies load on demand only: the catalog

carries names and descriptions, nothing more.
- No MCP server, no runtime dependencies, no writes ou

descriptions, nothing more.
- No MCP server, no runtime dependencies, no writes outside the package.

## Install into dsh
The plugin page accepts registry names, git hosts, tarballs and `file:` / `link:` paths:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Because the package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, dsh loads it as a profile layer. A package
without
that declaration is installed as a plain dependency and never mounted.

Manual alternative: add the dependency to `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`, append the
package
name to `dsh.profile.bundles`, run `pnpm install`, restart dsh.

aring in the catalog means the bundle is mounted.
## Plugin vs. copying into `~/.dsh/skills`
| | Bundle (this repo) | Loose directory |

| Distribution | npm / GitHub / tarball, one spec | unzip into `~/.dsh/skills` |
| Upgrade | bump ve

rsion, reinstall | overwrite directories |
| Scope | every workspace of that profile | every workspa

ce of that user |
| Source tag | `custom`, provider `medxpert-skills` | `user-dsh` |
| Collision | s
ame-name skills duplicate → remove the loose copies when switching | — |
